proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10930.1 explicitly includes Kumauni latā/lattā clothes and Punjabi nattā cloth used to wipe an oil press. Buksa lʌta and Dotyali nāt̚tā fit the documented l-/n- variants of the rag/cloth family, preserving the broader elicited sense and expressive etymology. Exact survey form nāt̚tā is preserved.
